periods.summary: Livia executes Rasputina with a time-folding curse, attacks Kinji and Aria at sea with water blades and waves, and ultimately forcibly teleports them away.
periods.cause: Moriarty and Livia set a trap near Suez while Nautilus and I-U approach.
periods.process: Kinji and Aria attempt to arrest/stop Livia, signal submarines, disrupt her collision wave, and grapple her in the surf.
periods.outcome: Kinji/Aria are expelled by teleport; Rasputina survives as a regressed child.
periods.significance: Introduces Livia, creates China, and prevents N's submarine ambush.
